translationDirection.title: Translation direction
translationDirection.description: auto: Chinese -> English when text contains Chinese intent, otherwise English -> Chinese. en-to-zh / zh-to-en force one direction.

translationPresentation.title: Translation result presentation
translationPresentation.description: dialog-preview: show multiline editable dialog (OK replaces selection, Cancel keeps original and offers Copy/Replace notification actions). notify-actions: notification toast only. replace-directly: replace immediately.

autoCopyTranslationOnCancel.title: Auto-copy translation when dialog is cancelled
autoCopyTranslationOnCancel.description: Copies the translation to the clipboard automatically if you dismiss the preview dialog instead of replacing.

includeCamelCase.title: Include camelCase (小驼峰)
includeCamelCase.description: Include lowerCamelCase style (for example userOrderAmount) in the structured Quick Pick list.

includePascalCase.title: Include PascalCase (大驼峰)
includePascalCase.description: Include UpperCamelCase style (for example UserOrderAmount) in the structured Quick Pick list.

includeSnakeCase.title: Include snake_case (下划线)
includeSnakeCase.description: Include lowercase underscore style (for example user_order_amount) in the structured Quick Pick list.

includeScreamingSnakeCase.title: Include SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE (全大写常量)
includeScreamingSnakeCase.description: Include constant uppercase underscore style (for example USER_ORDER_AMOUNT) in the structured Quick Pick list.

includeKebabCase.title: Include kebab-case (短横线)
includeKebabCase.description: Include hyphenated lowercase style (for example user-order-amount) in the structured Quick Pick list.

namingCandidateCount.title: Naming candidate groups
namingCandidateCount.description: Number of distinct English semantic candidates requested from the model (1 to 5). Each expands into all enabled case styles.

copyOnPickNaming.title: Also copy picked identifier to clipboard
copyOnPickNaming.description: Copies the chosen identifier after replacing the selection in the editor.

contextLines.title: Surrounding context lines
contextLines.description: Number of lines before and after the selection sent to help infer code semantics and language conventions (0 to 15).
